The build is green. 

## Summary

I changed the `customerCode` format from `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

- **`generateCustomerCode`** now takes the city as well as the last name. It builds `CITY3` (upper-cased first three letters of the city), `LAST3` (upper-cased first three letters of the last name), and `NNNN` — a **per-city** 4-digit zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the number of owners already in that city (comparing cities case-insensitively with trimmed/collapsed whitespace, matching the existing `normalizeHouseholdField` convention). The call site in `addOwner` now passes `owner.getCity()`.

- **Membership number** is derived from the customer code (`customerCode + "-M" + yy`) at creation time, so it automatically rebuilds on the new format — no separate change needed, satisfying the "every derived value must be rebuilt" requirement.

The acceptance test `coreCustomerCodeHasCityPrefix`, which asserts the code matches `[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}`, passes: **Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0 — BUILD SUCCESS**.
